fuel_vessels._how: Each vessel goes round: to_jt (empty, heading to JT) -> loading (at JT) -> to_aiambak (loaded) -> discharging (at Aiambak) -> to_jt. Change state as they move; for discharging give docked_at (time alongside at Aiambak) and cargo_l. tug and mmsi: the tug currently towing the barge (MarineTraffic tracks the mmsi); change them when tugs swap. Put JT's position in jt (lat, lon) and the dashboard will flag a vessel reaching it.
